judged_text: totalPages computes Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 instead of Math.ceil(user_count / limit), so the computed page count is one too high whenever the member count is an exact multiple of the limit. For a group with exactly 100 members at limit 50 the admin page shows 1/3, showingLast is false on the real last page (currentPage 2 vs totalPages 3) so the next arrow stays enabled, and clicking it clamps offset to user_count=100, fetches zero members, and lands the admin on an empty '3/3' page that presents as if all members vanished.

record.issue_text: [BUG] totalPages computes Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 instead of Math.ceil(user_count / limit), so the computed page count is one too high whenever the member count is an exact multiple of the limit. For a group with exactly 100 members at limit 50 the admin page shows 1/3, showingLast is false on the real last page (currentPage 2 vs totalPages 3) so the next arrow stays enabled, and clicking it clamps offset to user_count=100, fetches zero members, and lands the admin on an empty '3/3' page that presents as if all members vanished.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`, which overcounts when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 100/50 -> 3 instead of 2). Since `currentPage` is `Math.floor(offset/limit)+1`, on the true last page (`offset=50` => page 2) `showingLast` (`propertyEqual("currentPage","totalPages")`) remains false, leaving “next” enabled. Clicking “next” sets `offset` to `Math.min(offset+limit, user_count)` => 100, and `Group.findMembers()` requests `offset=100`, which the server (`groups_controller.rb#members`) will return as an empty `members` page. This matches the reported broken behavior.
